newsitem.title: UK: London tea auction sees strong and general demand.
newsitem.headline: London tea auction sees strong and general demand.

text.p: Demand remained strong and general at Monday's tea auction, the official report said.
Quality Assams sold well at between 150 and 200 pence per kilo. Coloury good liquoring invoices were fully firm around 130 to 140 pence, but plainer types tended easier.
Bright east Africans advanced five to eight pence with PD's still a strong feature. Coloury mediums and plainer descriptions were fully firm to often dearer.
The offshore sector met with good demand at firm rates.
The next auction will be held on Monday, September 9.
